// about: Copy to <project>/telemetry/rules.json and edit. Keys that start with // are comments. Schema: docs/telemetry.md
name: demo
// window: Only log events inside [from, to) are read. Leave a bound out (or null) for an open end.
// idle_cap_minutes: A gap between the end of a turn and the next human message counts as human active time up to this cap; the rest is reported as away.
// attribution: A turn belongs to the project when its cwd or git branch matches, or when any tool call in it mentions one of these. ~/ is also matched as the home directory.
// class_order: The classes, in the order that breaks a tie inside a mixed response.
// default_class: Class of a tool call that no rule below matches.
// classes: Checked top to bottom, first match wins. A rule matches a tool call when its tool name passes `tools` (if given; a trailing * is a prefix) and, if any of contains / path_prefixes / ids / cwd_prefixes is given, at least one of them hits. Text matchers look at the tool name plus its JSON input.
// dropped: Artifacts (paths or ids) that were thrown away. A response whose tool calls touched only these is reported as rework.
// takes_dirs: Take-record directories, relative to the project. Default: takes
